ui.collectionSubtitle: Make your icons part of the landscape.
ui.autostartTitle: Run IconScape automatically when you sign in
ui.autostartBlocked: Start with Windows may have been blocked
ui.autostartWarnSw: IconScape didn't start automatically this time — {sw} may have blocked it. Open {sw}, find IconScape in its startup manager and set it to Allow.
ui.autostartWarnGeneric: IconScape didn't start automatically this time — your security software or the Windows Startup apps setting may have blocked it. Turn IconScape on in your security software's startup manager, or in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.
ui.updateVersion: IconScape {version} is ready. Your current theme and settings will be kept.
ui.updateCompleted: The update has been downloaded and installed. If IconScape does not restart automatically, open it again.
ui.updateCanceled: The update was canceled. You can try again later.
ui.updateLowBattery: The update could not finish on battery power. Plug in your device and try again.
ui.updateWifiRecommended: This network may incur charges. Switch networks or try again later.
ui.updateWifiRequired: Connect to Wi-Fi to download this update.
ui.updateStoreRequired: This update method is only available in the Microsoft Store edition.
ui.updateFailed: The update failed. Check your connection or Microsoft Store and try again.
ui.updateChecking: Connecting to the update server and checking for a new version…
ui.networkTimeout: The connection or download timed out. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again. If other websites work, the server may also be responding slowly.
ui.networkDns: The server address couldn't be resolved. Check your network, DNS or proxy settings and try again.
ui.networkTls: A secure connection couldn't be established. Check the system time and any security interception by your network or proxy, then try again.
ui.networkLocal: The network connection failed or was interrupted. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again.
ui.serverUnavailable: The server was reached, but the service is temporarily unavailable (HTTP 5xx). Please try again later.
ui.serverRejected: The server rejected the request (HTTP 4xx). Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.serverInvalid: The server returned an unrecognized response. Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.downloadInvalid: The download was incomplete or failed security verification, so installation was stopped. Try again or contact support if this keeps happening.

ui.previewNoIcons: Live preview · desktop icons are hidden

ui.shareImageTitle: Share your desktop image while protecting your privacy
ui.shareVideoTitle: Share your desktop animation while protecting your privacy

ui.shareErrNoFrames: the picture did not move (the wallpaper may be completely covered)

ui.helpWallpaperQ: IconScape keeps flickering or restarting. How do I fix it?
ui.helpWallpaperA: If your regular Windows wallpaper changes automatically, each change can make IconScape flicker or restart. Use a fixed background that does not rotate.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: Set ‘Personalize your background’ to ‘Picture’ or ‘Solid color’. Do not use ‘Slideshow’ or ‘Windows spotlight’.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: Restart IconScape after changing this setting.
ui.ongoingDesc: New scenes and elements will be added over time.
ui.noParams: This theme has no settings yet

host.welcomeBody:
Click the IconScape icon in the system tray{hotkey} to open the menu.
Can't see it? Click ^ on the right side of the taskbar.
host.errBusyImage: The previous image is still being generated
host.errBusyVideo: The previous clip is still recording
host.errRebuilt: Windows kept rebuilding the wallpaper layer, so IconScape has stopped.
host.errNoDesktop: Couldn't find the desktop window, so the wallpaper can't be attached.

woodland.name: Storybook Woods
woodland.desc: A picture-book wood drawn like a classic cartoon: your icons float on ponds with water lilies, frogs and families of ducklings; around them round trees, red toadstools and flowers, bunnies, foxes and hedgehogs out for a stroll, bluebirds and butterflies; by day, at sunset or at night with fireflies

sigma.label: Pond size
sigma.hint: How far the pond extends around your icons

warp.label: Ragged shores
warp.hint: How irregular the outline of the ponds is

trees.label: Trees
trees.hint: How many trees and bushes grow in the meadow

flowers.label: Flowers
flowers.hint: How many flowers and toadstools grow in the meadow

animals.label: Animals
animals.hint: How many little animals wander on each monitor (bunnies, foxes, hedgehogs)

birds.label: Bluebirds
birds.hint: Little birds flying across the sky now and then

flow.label: Speed
flow.hint: How fast the animals, ducklings and butterflies move

ninja.name: Ninja Village
ninja.desc: A Japanese village drawn like a 1970s anime: houses seen from above with tiled roofs, white walls and timber, raked zen-garden sand, flat colours with ink outlines, hard shadows and film grain; stone lanterns, cherry blossoms or red maples, and a ninja who appears in a puff of smoke, leaps from roof to roof, throws a shuriken and vanishes

sigma.label: Roof size
sigma.hint: How far the roofs extend around your icons

warp.label: Roof outline
warp.hint: How irregular the outline of the roofs is

rake.label: Raked sand
rake.hint: How many sand grooves ring the roofs and rocks; 0 removes the sand

trees.label: Trees
trees.hint: How many trees and bamboo clumps grow on the moss

lanterns.label: Stone lanterns
lanterns.hint: Lit lanterns at the edge of the sand, per monitor

season.label: Season
season.hint: Spring brings cherry blossoms and petals, autumn red maples and leaves

leaves.label: Petals and leaves
leaves.hint: How many petals or leaves fall on each monitor

flow.label: Speed
flow.hint: How fast the petals and leaves fall

film.label: Film look
film.hint: Grain, scratches and dark edges of a 1970s animation film print

ninja.label: Show the ninja
ninja.hint: A ninja who now and then appears and leaps from roof to roof

manga.name: Manga
manga.desc: A black-and-white manga page: your icons sit on ink splashes bursting with impact lines; the panels are pen-and-hatching backgrounds: streets in perspective, the city at night, cumulonimbus and utility poles, mountains and pines, sea and rocks, bamboo, shrine steps, roofs and a pagoda under the moon, with sound effects, cherry petals and, now and then, a passing crow

sigma.label: Ink splash size
sigma.hint: How far the black ink spreads around your icons

warp.label: Ragged edges
warp.hint: How irregular the outline of the ink is

burst.label: Impact lines
burst.hint: Length of the spikes radiating from the ink

panels.label: Panels
panels.hint: How many panels divide the page: higher means smaller panels

sfx.label: Sound effects
sfx.hint: How often words like ドン or ゴゴゴ pop up

petals.label: Cherry petals
petals.hint: How many petals fall on each monitor

crow.label: Show the crow
crow.hint: A crow that crosses the page now and then

cosmos.name: Cosmos
cosmos.desc: Deep space: every group of icons is a star system, with orbits that follow its shape and planets travelling along them; around it nebulae, a turning galaxy, shooting stars, comets and the odd nova

sigma.label: Nebula extent
sigma.hint: How far the nebula and the dark pocket extend around your icons

stars.label: Stars
stars.hint: How many stars fill the background

orbits.label: Orbits
orbits.hint: Number of orbits around each group of icons

planets.label: Planets
planets.hint: Number of planets travelling along the orbits

speed.label: Speed
speed.hint: Speed of the planets and of the galaxy's rotation

galaxy.label: Show the galaxy
galaxy.hint: A spiral galaxy turning slowly in the free space

meteors.label: Shooting stars
meteors.hint: How many shooting stars cross the sky; now and then a comet passes too

steampunk.name: Steampunk
steampunk.desc: An old machine drawn by hand in pencil and watercolour: your icons sit on rusty patched sheets, gears turn and mesh, pipes lead to pressure gauges and puff steam, cables with light bulbs sag across the wall, and now and then a patched airship drifts by

sigma.label: Plate size
sigma.hint: How far the plates extend around your icons

gears.label: Gears
gears.hint: How many groups of gears fill the free space

speed.label: Speed
speed.hint: Speed of the gears and of the gauge needles

pipes.label: Pipes
pipes.hint: Number of copper pipes leaving the plates

steam.label: Steam
steam.hint: How much steam escapes from the pipe joints

airship.label: Show the airship
airship.hint: An airship that drifts over the machine now and then

isles.name: Floating Isles
isles.desc: Grassy islands float above a sea of clouds at dusk: your icons rest on the islands among glowing crystals, magic motes and, now and then, a passing dragon

sky.label: Sky color
sky.hint: The tint of the sky and of the sea of clouds below the islands

sigma.label: Island size
sigma.hint: How far the islands extend around your icons

warp.label: Ragged edges
warp.hint: How irregular the outline of the islands is

islets.label: Islets
islets.hint: Extra small islands floating away from the icons

trees.label: Trees
trees.hint: How many trees grow on the islands

crystals.label: Crystals
crystals.hint: Number of glowing crystals near the island edges

motes.label: Magic motes
motes.hint: Specks of light that slowly rise

flow.label: Movement speed
flow.hint: How quickly the clouds and motes move

dragon.label: Show the dragon
dragon.hint: A dragon that crosses the sky now and then

circuit.name: Circuit
circuit.desc: A dark printed circuit board: your icons sit on copper pours, traces fan out at 45° and data pulses run along them

sigma.label: Copper pour
sigma.hint: How far the copper pour extends around your icons

density.label: Trace density
density.hint: How many traces, chips and parts fill the board

pulses.label: Data pulses
pulses.hint: Number of bright dots running along the traces

speed.label: Speed
speed.hint: Speed of the pulses, the scan and the falling digits

rain.label: Digit rain
rain.hint: How many columns of hex digits fall over the board

scan.label: Scan band
scan.hint: A band of light sweeping the traces from top to bottom

beach.name: Beach
beach.desc: The shoreline curves around your files as waves roll up the sand

palms.label: Coconut palms
palms.hint: Number of coastal palms; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough sand.

sigma.label: Distance from icons
sigma.hint: How far the shoreline sits from your icons

warp.label: Winding coast
warp.hint: How much the shoreline twists and turns

shoal.label: Clear shallows
shoal.hint: How wide the see-through water over the sand is

shallow.label: Shallow sea
shallow.hint: How far the water fades from turquoise to deep blue

meadow.name: Meadow
meadow.desc: A pen-and-wash meadow where your icons hide in white clouds that cast dark green shadows

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

cover.label: Clouds over the meadow
cover.hint: How many clouds drift over the open meadow

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

showBoy.label: Show boy
showBoy.hint: Show or hide the boy together with his kite

showCat.label: Show kitten
showCat.hint: The little black kitten resting on the grass
